import re
from importlib.util import find_spec


def _sanitize_help_text(help_text: str) -> str:
    """Sanitize help text by removing rich tags if rich is installed."""
    if find_spec("rich"):
        # Remove rich tags like [bold]text[/bold]
        help_text = re.sub(r'\[\w+\]', '', help_text)
    return help_text
